```{r load-gazetteer-data, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON("russian_civil_war_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
sum_json <- jsonlite::fromJSON((if (file.exists("russian_civil_war_summary.json")) "russian_civil_war_summary.json" else "../../_shared/_gis_cache/russian_civil_war_summary.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

all_entries <- unname(gaz_map)
regs <- sum_json$regions
reg_ids <- vapply(regs, function (r) as.character(r$id), character(1))
reg_num_map <- setNames(seq_along(reg_ids), reg_ids)

fmt_eu_pop <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", as.character(m)), "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", as.character(k)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function (arg0_x) {
  return(gsub("\\.", ",", as.character(round(as.numeric(arg0_x), 2))))
}

hyphenate_long_words <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  known_map <- c(
    "Novonikolaevsk" = "Novo-nikolaevsk",
    "Dnepropetrovsk" = "Dnepro-petrovsk",
    "Blagoveshchensk" = "Blago-veshchensk",
    "Krasnokokshaysk" = "Krasno-kokshaysk",
    "Starokonstantinov" = "Staro-konstantinov",
    "Konstantinograd" = "Konstantino-grad",
    "Krasnoarmeysk" = "Krasno-armeysk",
    "Swietokrzyski" = "Swietok-rzyski",
    "Kremenchuk" = "Kremen-chuk",
    "Novocherkassk" = "Novocher-kassk",
    "Aleksandrovsk-Grushevsky" = "Aleksan-drovsk-Grushevsky",
    "Aleksandrovsk-Sakhalinsky" = "Aleksan-drovsk-Sakhalinsky",
    "Makhachkala" = "Makhach-kala",
    "Novokuznetsk" = "Novokuz-netsk",
    "Monastyrskoe" = "Monastyr-skoe",
    "Verkhneudinsk" = "Verkhne-udinsk",
    "Petropavlovsk" = "Petropav-lovsk"
  )
  for (nm in names(known_map)) {
    s <- gsub(nm, known_map[[nm]], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  s <- gsub("([A-Za-z]{7})([A-Za-z]{7,})", "\\1-\\2", s, perl = TRUE)
  return(s)
}

get_p <- function (arg0_e, arg1_yr) {
  v <- arg0_e$population[[arg1_yr]]
  if (is.null(v)) return(NA_real_)
  return(as.numeric(v))
}

build_reg48_df <- function (arg0_reg_nums) {
  target_ids <- reg_ids[arg0_reg_nums]
  sub_entries <- Filter(function (e) as.character(e$region_id) %in% target_ids, all_entries)
  rows <- lapply(sub_entries, function (e) {
    rnum <- reg_num_map[[as.character(e$region_id)]]
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    oth_part <- if (length(raw_oth) > 0) paste0(" [", raw_oth[1], "]") else ""
    coord_str <- paste0(fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), "N, ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]), "E")
    label_str <- hyphenate_long_words(paste0(e$name, oth_part, " (R", rnum, ")"))
    data.frame(
      `Settlement (Reg.)` = label_str,
      `Coords` = coord_str,
      `1914` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1914")),
      `1917` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1917")),
      `1918` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1918")),
      `1919` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1919")),
      `1920` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1920")),
      `1921` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1921")),
      `1922` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1922")),
      `1924` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1924")),
      `1926` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1926")),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, rows))
}

GAZ_COL_FRACS <- c(0.245, 0.115, rep(0.0545, 9))
```

# Abstract

Between 1914 and 1926 the towns of the former Russian Empire went through two sharp upheavals. First World War evacuations emptied the western borderland cities of Riga, Liepaja, Kovno, Vilna and Warsaw while crowding rear garrison and railway towns in the interior; then food and fuel shortages under War Communism cut Petrograd by 70,2% and Moscow by nearly half between 1917 and 1920 before the New Economic Policy (*NEP*) and post-war refugee returns restored urban trade and industry. This gazetteer presents population figures for 275 urban settlements across the 48 pre-war provinces (18,61M km2) at nine benchmark dates from 1914 to 1926.

# Methodology

The settlement series are drawn from the 1914 Russian statistical yearbooks, the 1917 town census [@vseros1917gorod], the 28 August 1920 Russian census [@tsu1920perepis], the 1920 Finnish census [@svt1923finland], the 1920 and 1925 Latvian censuses [@skujenieks1927latvia], the 30 September 1921 Polish census [@gus1921skorowidz; @barwinski2015ethnic], the 15 February 1921 Czechoslovak census [@csr1924scitani], the 28 December 1922 Estonian census [@estonia1924rahvaloendus], the 17 September 1923 Lithuanian census [@lithuania1926gyventojai], Romanian municipal counts for Bessarabia and Bukovina [@tartakovsky2009bessarabia; @fondos2024bessarabia], the 15 March 1923 Soviet urban census [@tsu1923gorod] and the 17 December 1926 All-Union Census [@tsu1926vsesoyuznaya; @koenker1985urbanization; @volkov1930dinamika].

# Results

## Regions 1 - 4: Former Congress Poland

Table \ref{tab:reg1-4} gives population figures for 23 towns across Warsaw, Plock and Lomza (Region 1), Piotrkow and Kalisz (Region 2), Lublin, Siedlce and Kholm (Region 3) and Radom, Kielce and Suwalki (Region 4) [@gus1921skorowidz; @barwinski2015ethnic; @gatrell1999whole].

```{r table-reg1-4, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
render_table_template(
  build_reg48_df(1:4),
  list(
    caption = "Urban populations in the ten Vistula provinces, showing the 1915 evacuation losses in Warsaw, Lodz and Lublin and post-1921 recovery under the Second Polish Republic.",
    label = "tab:reg1-4",
    col_fracs = GAZ_COL_FRACS
  )
)
```

## Regions 5 - 9: Baltic Provinces and Finland

Table \ref{tab:reg5-9} covers 28 ports and inland towns across Estland (Region 5), Livland (Region 6), Courland (Region 7), Southern Finland (Region 8) and Interior and Northern Finland (Region 9) [@myrskyla2023finnish; @rantala2020warvictims; @gusachenko2021latvia; @estonia1924rahvaloendus; @skujenieks1927latvia; @svt1923finland].

```{r table-reg5-9, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
render_table_template(
  build_reg48_df(5:9),
  list(
    caption = "Urban populations in the Baltic provinces and Finland, reflecting factory evacuations from Riga and Courland (1915-1917) and the 1918 Finnish Civil War.",
    label = "tab:reg5-9",
    col_fracs = GAZ_COL_FRACS
  )
)
```

## Regions 10 - 16: Lithuania, Belarus, Galicia, Bukovina and Bessarabia

Table \ref{tab:reg10-16} lists 42 towns across Kovno (Region 10), Vilna and Grodno (Region 11), Minsk (Region 12), Vitebsk and Mogilev (Region 13), Eastern Galicia (Region 14), Bukovina and Subcarpathian Rus (Region 15) and Bessarabia (Region 16) [@balkelis2018war; @marcinkevicius2026lithuania; @cichoracki2014polesia; @mick2016galicia; @tartakovsky2009bessarabia; @bondarenko2019bessarabia].

```{r table-reg10-16, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

```

# Appendix

## Regional Urban Summary

Table \ref{tab:reg48-summary} compares the area, number of catalogued towns, total regional population (1914, 1922 and 1926) and combined population of the catalogued settlements (1914, 1920 and 1926) across each of the 48 pre-war provinces.

```{r table-reg48-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
fmt_k_or_m <- function (arg0_val_k) {
  val_k <- as.numeric(arg0_val_k)
  if (val_k >= 1000) {
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", as.character(round(val_k / 1000, 2))), "M"))
  }
  return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", as.character(round(val_k, 1))), "k"))
}

clean_reg_label <- function (nm) {
  s <- trimws(strsplit(strsplit(as.character(nm), "\\(")[[1]][1], ":")[[1]][1])
  s <- sub("^15\\. .*$", "15. Bukovina & Subcarpathian Rus", s)
  s <- sub("^43\\. .*$", "43. Tomsk & Altai", s)
  s <- sub("^47\\. .*$", "47. Transbaikal & Yakutsk Oblasts", s)
  s <- sub("^48\\. .*$", "48. Priamurye, Amur & Sakhalin", s)
  return(s)
}

sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(regs), function (i) {
  r <- regs[[i]]
  rid <- as.character(r$id)
  sub_e <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(e$region_id), rid), all_entries)
  n_c <- length(sub_e)
  u14 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1914"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  u20 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1920"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  u26 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1926"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  short_nm <- clean_reg_label(r$name)
  data.frame(
    `Province / Region` = short_nm,
    `Area (km2)` = fmt_eu_pop(r$area_km2),
    `Towns` = as.character(n_c),
    `Reg 1914` = fmt_k_or_m(r$population_k[["1914"]]),
    `Reg 1922` = fmt_k_or_m(r$population_k[["1922"]]),
    `Reg 1926` = fmt_k_or_m(r$population_k[["1926"]]),
    `Urb 1914` = fmt_k_or_m(u14),
    `Urb 1920` = fmt_k_or_m(u20),
    `Urb 1926` = fmt_k_or_m(u26),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

tot_u14 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1914"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
tot_u20 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1920"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
tot_u26 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1926"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Province / Region` = "Total (All 48 Pre-War Regions)",
  `Area (km2)` = fmt_eu_pop(sum_json$total_area_km2),
  `Towns` = as.character(length(all_entries)),
  `Reg 1914` = fmt_k_or_m(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1914"]]),
  `Reg 1922` = fmt_k_or_m(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1922"]]),
  `Reg 1926` = fmt_k_or_m(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1926"]]),
  `Urb 1914` = fmt_k_or_m(tot_u14),
  `Urb 1920` = fmt_k_or_m(tot_u20),
  `Urb 1926` = fmt_k_or_m(tot_u26),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  rbind(do.call(rbind, sum_rows), tot_row),
  list(
    caption = "Provincial areas, number of catalogued settlements, total regional populations (1914, 1922 and 1926) and combined urban populations (1914, 1920 and 1926).",
    label = "tab:reg48-summary",
    col_fracs = c(0.28, 0.07, 0.055, rep(0.068, 6))
  )
)
```
